test_1_cross_domain.prompt: Once upon a time, the little girl asked her father, how do computers work?
test_1_cross_domain.full_generated_response: Once upon a time, the little girl Lily sat by the warm fireplace with her favorite storybook. She looked up at her father with curious eyes and asked gently, "Dad, how do computers work?" Her father smiled and explained that a computer works by processing binary signals of zeros and ones through millions of microscopic silicon logic gates inside the central processing unit (CPU) and storing instructions in fast electronic memory. Lily clapped her hands happily, realizing that even a magical machine follows clear logical steps.
